description: An exploration of Kiswahili semantics covering types of meaning, sense relations between words, context-based interpretation, idioms, and meaning change.

mcq.questionText: Semantiki ni nini katika taaluma ya lugha?

options.text: Ni taaluma inayochunguza maana za maneno na tungo
Ni taaluma inayochunguza sauti za lugha
Ni taaluma inayochunguza muundo wa sentensi
Ni taaluma inayochunguza historia ya lugha

mcq.explanation: Semantics is the branch of linguistics that studies the meaning of words and sentences.

mcq.questionText: Maana ya msingi ya neno ni ipi?

options.text: Maana ya ziada inayotokana na mazingira
Maana ya kamusi au maana halisi ya neno

mcq.explanation: Basic (denotative) meaning is the literal dictionary meaning of a word.

mcq.questionText: Neno 'nyumba' na 'jumba' yana uhusiano gani wa kimaana?
mcq.explanation: Synonyms (visawe) are words with the same or very similar meaning, like 'nyumba' and 'jumba'.

mcq.questionText: Maneno 'kubwa' na 'dogo' ni mfano wa nini?
mcq.explanation: Antonyms (vinyume) are words with opposite meanings, such as 'kubwa' (big) and 'dogo' (small).

mcq.questionText: Neno moja lenye maana nyingi zinazohusiana huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Polysemy (polisemia) is when one word has several related meanings.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Mtoto amefungua mlango', neno 'mlango' limetumika kwa maana ya msingi. Hii ina maana gani?

options.text: Limetumika kwa maana yake halisi ya kamusi

mcq.explanation: Here 'mlango' (door) is used in its literal, basic dictionary sense.

mcq.questionText: Maneno 'paa' (kuruka juu) na 'paa' (sehemu ya juu ya nyumba) ni mfano wa nini?
mcq.explanation: Homonyms (homonimu) are words spelt and pronounced the same but with unrelated meanings.

mcq.questionText: Uhusiano wa neno la jumla na maneno mahususi yaliyo chini yake huitwaje? Mfano: 'mnyama' na 'simba, mbuzi, ng'ombe'.
mcq.explanation: Hyponymy (hiponimia) is the relationship where specific words fall under a general (superordinate) term.

mcq.questionText: Nahau 'kupiga chuku' ina maana gani ya kificho?
mcq.explanation: The idiom 'kupiga chuku' means to exaggerate, not its literal words.

mcq.questionText: Neno lenye maana pana ni lipi kati ya haya?
mcq.explanation: 'Mti' (tree) has a broad meaning that includes specific trees like 'mwembe' and 'mbuyu'.

mcq.questionText: Maana ya ziada (picha) ya neno hutokana na nini?

options.text: Hisia, mazingira na utamaduni unaohusishwa na neno

mcq.explanation: Connotative (additional) meaning arises from the feelings, associations and culture linked to a word.

mcq.questionText: Maneno 'sita' (namba 6) na 'sita' (kusitasita) yanafanana kwa matamshi na maandishi lakini maana zake hazihusiani. Ni mfano wa nini?
mcq.explanation: Because they share spelling and pronunciation but have unrelated meanings, they are homonyms.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Alikula kiapo mbele ya hakimu', neno 'kula' limetumika kwa maana gani?

options.text: Maana ya msingi ya kumeza chakula

mcq.explanation: 'Kula kiapo' is an idiomatic use meaning to take an oath, not literally to eat.

mcq.questionText: Mabadiliko ya maana ya maneno kutoka maana finyu kwenda maana pana huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Widening (upanuzi wa maana) is when a word's meaning broadens from a narrow to a wider sense.

mcq.questionText: Muktadha husaidiaje katika kufafanua maana ya neno lenye maana zaidi ya moja?

options.text: Hubainisha maana inayokusudiwa kwa kuzingatia maneno mengine na hali ya matumizi

mcq.explanation: Context determines the intended meaning by considering surrounding words and the situation of use.

fib.questionText: Taaluma inayochunguza maana za maneno na tungo katika lugha huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The study of meaning of words and sentences is called semantics (semantiki).

fib.questionText: Maneno yenye maana sawa au inayokaribiana, kama 'furaha' na 'raha', huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Words with the same or similar meaning are synonyms (visawe).

fib.questionText: Maneno yenye maana zinazopingana, kama 'juu' na 'chini', huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Words with opposite meanings are antonyms (vinyume).

fib.questionText: Neno moja lenye maana nyingi zinazohusiana huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A single word with several related meanings is polysemy (polisemia).

fib.questionText: Maana halisi ya neno kama inavyotolewa katika kamusi huitwa maana ya _____.
fib.explanation: The literal dictionary meaning is the basic (msingi) meaning.

fib.questionText: Uhusiano wa neno la jumla 'ndege' na maneno mahususi 'tai, kware, njiwa' huitwa _____.
Maneno yenye matamshi na maandishi sawa lakini maana tofauti zisizohusiana huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Words pronounced and spelt the same but with unrelated meanings are homonyms (homonimu).

fib.questionText: Nahau '_____ chuku' ina maana ya kutia chumvi au kuzidisha jambo.
fib.explanation: The idiom 'kupiga chuku' means to exaggerate.

fib.questionText: Maana inayotokana na hisia na mazingira yanayohusishwa na neno huitwa maana ya _____.
fib.explanation: Meaning arising from feelings and associations is additional/connotative (ziada) meaning.

fib.questionText: Hali ya neno kupata maana mpya au kupoteza maana yake ya zamani kadiri muda unavyopita huitwa _____ ya maana.
fib.explanation: The process of words gaining or losing meanings over time is meaning change (mabadiliko ya maana).

tf.questionText: Semantiki ni taaluma inayochunguza maana za maneno.
tf.explanation: Yes, semantics studies the meaning of words.

tf.questionText: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana zinazopingana.
tf.explanation: False; synonyms have similar meaning. Words with opposite meanings are antonyms (vinyume).

tf.questionText: Maana ya msingi ya neno ni ile ya kamusi au maana halisi.
tf.explanation: True; basic meaning is the literal dictionary meaning.

tf.questionText: Polisemia ni neno moja lenye maana nyingi zinazohusiana.
tf.explanation: True; that is the definition of polysemy.

tf.questionText: Nahau huleta maana ya moja kwa moja ya maneno yanayoiunda.
tf.explanation: False; idioms carry a hidden, figurative meaning different from the literal words.

tf.questionText: Katika hiponimia, neno 'samaki' ni neno la jumla kuliko 'pweza' kama tunaongelea viumbe vya majini.
tf.explanation: False; 'samaki' (fish) is not a superordinate of 'pweza' (octopus); the broader term would be 'viumbe vya majini'.

tf.questionText: Homonimu ni maneno yanayofanana kwa matamshi na maandishi lakini yana maana tofauti.
Muktadha hauna umuhimu wowote katika kubainisha maana ya neno lenye maana nyingi.
tf.explanation: False; context is essential for determining the intended meaning of a polysemous word.

tf.questionText: Maana za maneno zinaweza kubadilika kadiri muda na matumizi yanavyobadilika.
tf.explanation: True; word meanings change over time through use (meaning change).

summary.questionText: Eleza kwa ufupi maana ya semantiki.
summary.correctAnswer: Semantiki ni tawi la isimu linalochunguza maana za maneno, tungo na sentensi katika lugha.
summary.explanation: Semantics is the branch of linguistics that studies the meaning of words and sentences.

summary.questionText: Taja na ueleze kwa kifupi aina mbili kuu za maana ya neno.
summary.correctAnswer: Maana ya msingi ni maana halisi ya kamusi, na maana ya ziada/picha ni maana inayotokana na hisia na mazingira yanayohusishwa na neno.
summary.explanation: The two main types are basic (denotative) and additional (connotative) meaning.

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya visawe na vinyume kwa kutoa mfano mmoja kila kimoja.
summary.correctAnswer: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana inayofanana mfano 'njia' na 'barabara'; vinyume ni maneno yenye maana zinazopingana mfano 'mzuri' na 'mbaya'.
summary.explanation: Synonyms share meaning while antonyms have opposite meanings.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya polisemia kwa kutoa mfano.
summary.correctAnswer: Polisemia ni neno moja lenye maana nyingi zinazohusiana, mfano neno 'kichwa' linaweza kumaanisha sehemu ya mwili, kiongozi, au mwanzo wa habari.
summary.explanation: Polysemy is one word with multiple related senses, exemplified by 'kichwa'.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya homonimu na utoe mfano.
summary.correctAnswer: Homonimu ni maneno yanayofanana kwa matamshi na maandishi lakini yana maana tofauti zisizohusiana, mfano 'paa' (kuruka) na 'paa' (sehemu ya juu ya nyumba).
summary.explanation: Homonyms share form but have unrelated meanings, like the two senses of 'paa'.

summary.questionText: Eleza dhana ya hiponimia kwa kutoa mfano.
summary.correctAnswer: Hiponimia ni uhusiano wa neno la jumla na maneno mahususi yaliyo chini yake, mfano 'maua' ni neno la jumla likijumuisha 'waridi, alizeti na yungiyungi'.
summary.explanation: Hyponymy links a general term to its specific members.

summary.questionText: Eleza umuhimu wa muktadha katika kubainisha maana ya neno.
summary.correctAnswer: Muktadha husaidia kubainisha maana iliyokusudiwa ya neno lenye maana zaidi ya moja kwa kuzingatia maneno mengine na hali ya matumizi.
summary.explanation: Context helps identify the intended meaning of words with multiple senses.

summary.questionText: Nahau ni nini na zina maana gani?
summary.correctAnswer: Nahau ni fungu la maneno lenye maana ya kificho isiyofuata maana halisi ya maneno, mfano 'kuvunja moyo' humaanisha kukatisha tamaa.
summary.explanation: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative meanings, like 'kuvunja moyo' (to discourage).

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya neno lenye maana pana na neno lenye maana finyu kwa mfano.
summary.correctAnswer: Neno lenye maana pana hujumuisha vitu vingi mfano 'chombo', wakati neno lenye maana finyu hubainisha kitu mahususi mfano 'kikombe'.
summary.explanation: Broad words cover many items; narrow words specify a particular item.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya mabadiliko ya maana ya maneno na utoe namna mojawapo yanavyotokea.
summary.correctAnswer: Mabadiliko ya maana ni hali ya neno kupata maana mpya au kupoteza maana ya zamani kadiri muda unavyopita, mfano kwa upanuzi wa maana ambapo neno hupata maana pana zaidi.
summary.explanation: Meaning change is the process of words shifting meaning over time, e.g. through widening.

hoq.questionText: Soma sentensi: 'Baada ya kushinda, wachezaji walipiga makofi na kufurahia ushindi.' Katika muktadha huu, neno 'kupiga' lina maana gani na ni kipengele kipi cha kisemantiki kinachoonekana?

options.text: Lina maana ya kuumiza, hivyo ni kinyume
Lina maana inayotegemea muktadha, likionyesha polisemia ya neno 'kupiga'
Lina maana ya kamusi pekee bila muktadha

hoq.explanation: 'Kupiga' has many related senses (kupiga makofi, kupiga simu, kupiga picha); the meaning here depends on context, illustrating polysemy.

hoq.questionText: Mwalimu alisema: 'Asha ni mwanafunzi mwenye mkono mrefu.' Kwa kuzingatia semantiki, kauli hii inapaswa kueleweka vipi?

options.text: Kwa maana ya msingi kwamba mkono wake ni mrefu kimwili
Kwa maana ya ziada/kinahau kwamba Asha ana tabia ya kuiba

hoq.explanation: 'Mkono mrefu' is an idiom whose hidden meaning is that someone tends to steal, an example of connotative/idiomatic meaning.

hoq.questionText: Zingatia kundi la maneno: 'kiatu, ndara, raba, buti'. Kati ya chaguo zifuatazo, ipi inaonyesha vyema uhusiano wa kisemantiki katika kundi hili?

options.text: Yote ni vinyume vya kila kimoja
Yote ni hiponimu za neno la jumla 'viatu'
Yote ni polisemia ya neno moja

hoq.explanation: All these are specific kinds of footwear (hyponyms) under the superordinate term 'viatu', illustrating hyponymy.
